name: bytheslice
description: Marketplace for ByTheSlice, the pizza-shop delivery loop plugin: Pies, Slices, and an autonomous baker.

plugins.name: bytheslice
plugins.description: ByTheSlice runs your project like a grab-and-go pizza shop. v5 delivers in Pies (3 to 8 slice chapters, one PR each). Everyday loop: /sell-pie bakes a whole Pie autonomously (context-separated build/test/verify/fix per slice), then /box-it-up opens the PR, watches CI, and merges. /sell-slice is the high-touch single-slice variant. One-time prep: /setup-shop, /create-menu, /cook-pizzas, /set-display-case, /final-quality-check, /open-the-shop. All 49 live subagents natively registered with enforced model tiers, tool allowlists, and effort levels.
